coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma named only in a registered arm label (Cohort 7) and keywords, so basket_gbm_eligible per D27B. The GBM cohort is BAY 3713372 alone (window-of-opportunity before definitive surgery); setting (newly diagnosed vs recurrent) not stated. Cohorts 3, 4 and 6 (NSCLC, PDAC) combine BAY 3713372 with unnamed 'other treatments' that are not registered interventions, so not listed as agents; regimen coded combination on that basis, although the GBM cohort is monotherapy. MTAP deletion is a whole-trial entry requirement matched to the PRMT5 inhibitor.
